title: Triangle read by rows: packings of connected edge sets with at most 4 edges in K_n, by number of pieces.
definition: T(n,k) counts unordered sets of k pairwise vertex-disjoint nonempty connected edge sets, each with at most 4 edges, in the labelled complete graph K_n. Unused vertices are allowed; distinct edge sets on the same support count separately. n >= 0, 0 <= k <= floor(n/2); the empty packing contributes 1.
generating_function: sum_{n>=0} C_n(t) z^n/n! = exp(z + t B(z)), B(z) = sum_{r>=2} w_r z^r/r!.

references.locator: Complete graphs at edge caps four and five

real_rootedness.statement: Conjecture: every nonconstant row has simple negative zeros.

finite_range.evidence: Reported exact rational sign brackets in public RealRooted issue #2646; consecutive pairs through (119,120).

interlacing.statement: Conjecture: zeros of consecutive rows strictly alternate, including equal-degree pairs.
